info.title: spm
info.description: spm (Skills Package Manager) — a CLI, interactive REPL, and MCP server that installs AI agent skills from Git catalogs into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, Cursor, Cline, Devin, Aider, and Open Interpreter.
